message: The non-streaming request of POST /chat (name generated from operationId "chat") is named "ChatRequest", which is already declared by the schema schemas.yaml#/ChatRequest (which Fern copies into components.schemas when it bundles the document) at schemas.yaml#/ChatRequest. fern check fails with "ChatRequest is already declared". Fern splits an operation with an x-fern-streaming stream-condition into a streaming and a non-streaming endpoint, each with its own request. Name the two requests with x-fern-request-name on the operation and stream-request-name in x-fern-streaming.
